Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Girish Kathpalia
 Order

1. Petitioners seek quashing of FIR No. 624/2021 of PS Nand Nagari for offences under Section 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that they have compromised the disputes with the complainant de facto (respondent no.2).
2.
Learned ASC for the State and respondent no.2 in person (identified by Investigating Officer/SI Devender Singh) accept notice.
3. Parties shall appear before the concerned Joint Registrar for recording their statements on 17.07.2025.
